sampling_rule: Every 6th record counting from the first (1-based record_index 1, 7, 13, 19, ...) of each file's `records` array, taken in file order. No file yielded fewer than 3 records, so the first-3 fallback was not used. Each record was checked against its stated pdf_page_index only, viewed as a rendered page image; no other page was searched. Judged against the page, not the record's own notes.
